# Psalm 73 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 73:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For I-was-envious of-the-arrogant; the-prosperity-of the-wicked I-would-see.
- **LOGOS:** For I was envious of the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
- **PNEUMA:** Because I couldn't help but envy the arrogant when I saw how well the wicked were doing.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
